correctness.rationale: Every maximal independent set of K_1 join disjoint union_i K_(m_i) is the hub singleton or a one-vertex transversal across all r blocks, giving P+1 outputs. The hub is first in a uniform vertex permutation with probability 1/(M+1); otherwise it is rejected and each block minimum is chosen. Independent permutation symmetries act transitively on tuples of block minima conditional on hub not first, giving each transversal mass M/((M+1)P). Total variation from uniform is |P-M|/((M+1)(P+1)), zero iff P=M. Family blade sizes (2,q,1 repeated q-2 times) has M=P=2q, one singleton and 2q maximal sets of size q, unbounded size discrepancy. Independently literally enumerated all permutations for five small bouquets, matching exact probabilities and total variation identity.
